items.title: How Poliscope Made All of Germany's Local Politics Searchable on One Server with Qdrant
items.summary: Poliscope makes Germany’s local political data searchable in one place. Germany has about 11,000 municipalities, and almost every one of them publishes through a council information system (in German, a Ratsinformationssystem). That is where agendas, minutes, proposals, and planning documents get published. Many portals serve several municipalities at once, so Poliscope’s roughly 4,800 active portals cover about 90% of German municipalities and 98% of the population. They run on roughly a dozen software products, each with its own quirks, and none of them talk to each other.
